def transform(grid):
    """Replace all cells NOT part of any 2x2 block of the same color with background"""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Find background color (most common)
    from collections import Counter
    all_vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = Counter(all_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    
    # Find which cells are part of at least one 2x2 block
    is_in_2x2 = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            # Check all possible 2x2 blocks containing (r,c)
            # A 2x2 block top-left can be at (r,c), (r-1,c), (r,c-1), (r-1,c-1)
            for top in [r-1, r]:
                for left in [c-1, c]:
                    if 0 <= top < h-1 and 0 <= left < w-1:
                        # Check 2x2 block
                        if (grid[top][left] == grid[top][left+1] == 
                            grid[top+1][left] == grid[top+1][left+1]):
                            # Mark all 4 cells in this 2x2 as being in 2x2
                            for dr in [0, 1]:
                                for dc in [0, 1]:
                                    rr, cc = top + dr, left + dc
                                    is_in_2x2[rr][cc] = True
    
    # Replace cells NOT in any 2x2 with background
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not is_in_2x2[r][c]:
                result[r][c] = bg

                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            component_cells = [(r, c)]
            queue = [(r, c)]
            visited[r][c] = True
            while queue:
                nr, nc = queue.pop(0)
                for dr, dc in [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]:

                    if 0 <= nnr < h and 0 <= nnc < w and not visited[nnr][nnc] and grid[nnr][nnc] == color:
